response.sql:
WITH per_order_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_of_per_order_averages,
  SUM(exec_count) as total_exec_count
FROM per_order_stats;

assumptions.assumption: The schema defines expirespot as text(6), which appears too small for ISO 8601 timestamps (19+ chars). We assume the column actually stores full timestamp strings as documented, and text comparison (lexicographic ordering) correctly orders them.

alternatives.interpretation: Include only execution counts from orders where at least one remaincount value is non-NULL (i.e., exclude orders with entirely NULL remaincount columns from the total count).

    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions

    AND expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_of_per_order_averages,
  SUM(exec_count) as total_exec_count
FROM per_order_stats
WHERE avg_remaincount IS NOT NULL;
